description: Per page: snapshot after load, then after each step. Steps run as page JavaScript in both tools so the DOM changes are identical.

steps.name: type into the first text field
steps.script: (() => { const field = document.querySelector('input[type=search], input:not([type]), input[type=email], textarea'); if (!field) return false; field.value = 'transit plan'; field.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return true; })()

steps.name: tick a checkbox and show a status message
steps.script: (() => { const box = document.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]:not(:checked)'); if (box) box.checked = true; const status = document.createElement('div'); status.setAttribute('role', 'status'); status.textContent = 'Saved 1 item'; (document.querySelector('main') || document.body).appendChild(status); return true; })()

steps.name: update the page heading
steps.script: (() => { const heading = document.querySelector('h1, h2'); heading.textContent = heading.textContent + ' (updated)'; return true; })()
